reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) does not mention HfMoTaTiZr, its properties, or the effect of Nb substitution on density or strength in this system. The key premises about density reduction, BCC stability, and retained strengthening mechanisms are therefore unsupported by the provided passages.
premises: Partial Ta→Nb substitution reduces density by lowering average atomic mass.
Nb and Ta both stabilize a single-phase BCC structure in HfMoTaTiZr.
Solid-solution strengthening and dislocation glide remain effective after substitution.
Lattice distortion change from Nb substitution has minimal impact on mechanical properties.
As-cast HfMoTaTiZr baseline properties are ~10.21 g/cm³, ~1600 MPa RT yield, ~855 MPa at 1000 °C.
